answer.rationale: p99 latency is 5x target confined to primary region with heavy settlement writes at peak. Rollback is blocked by mandatory security patch. Regional failover (memory_b2) successfully restored latency in 90 minutes with clean traffic shift during prior degradation; this is proven effective for regional latency issues. Adding capacity (memory_b3) requires provisioning time we don't have during settlement peak. Circuit breakers and read replicas won't address write path latency. Failover preserves the security patch, maintains write integrity during peak load, and has documented success restoring regional write performance. Verify memory_b2 for failover mechanics and memory_b3 to confirm capacity constraints during peak windows.
